llm.summary: This appears to be a legitimate Salesforce integration, but it can change CRM records and create ongoing automations, so approvals and least-privilege setup matter.

dimensions.detail: Network access, a Maton account, OAuth connections, and Salesforce data access are proportionate to the integration; the skill advises narrow Salesforce scopes, sandbox use for destructive work, and avoiding broad exports of person records.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is disclosed and version-pinned for the CLI and SDK examples; the artifact contains Markdown instructions and trigger references, with no bundled executable scripts found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly scopes sensitive actions: default to read/list operations, require explicit user approval for new connections, writes, deletions, batch/composite calls, functions, trigger destinations, and local event execution, and treat third-party payload text as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations are persistent or high-impact capabilities, but they are disclosed with approval, deletion, private function, and DENY_ALL network-policy guidance rather than hidden automatic setup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Salesforce CRM API access through Maton, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: SOQL queries, sObject CRUD, composite/batch calls, managed OAuth, optional raw HTTP fallback, and hosted functions/triggers for user-approved automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you need Salesforce administration through Maton. Use the narrowest Salesforce scopes available, prefer read-only and sandbox connections when possible, verify the connection ID before writes, and approve only specific record changes or automation destinations after reviewing exactly what data will be changed or forwarded.
